## Media server
Meta fetches `image_url` / `cover_url` from a public URL, so this tiny webhook serves the rendered files from `<data_dir>/out`.

URL: `https://<your-n8n>/webhook/ig-media?f=<file name>` -> put `https://<your-n8n>/webhook/ig-media?f=` into `public_media_url` in both Config nodes.

Activate it first. Only plain file names from `out/` can be read (path traversal is rejected). Note: Meta could not fetch *videos* from here (n8n answers HEAD with 404 and sends no Range support), which is why reels use the resumable upload instead.
